inputs.name: JSON
inputs.description: (optional) Layout2 JSON string used as the merge base.

inputs.name: Label
inputs.description: (required when nested) matches an entry in the parent's CellLabels grid.

inputs.name: Mirror
inputs.description: Mirrors this node's own CellWidths/CellLabels column order (WIDTH axis only -- CellLengths/row order never flips) and CASCADES to every descendant automatically (hosted children and this node's own walls all mirror too, no per-node opt-out) -- consumed by Geom2, not this component. Mirroring one apartment node mirrors the whole apartment into a mirrored copy of itself, not just its own outermost grid. Unwired = not mirrored, same as False.

inputs.name: Boundary
inputs.description: (root use only) a Rectangle3d (plane + width + height). Its plane is copied straight into this document's 'plane' field; its width/height seed CellWidths/CellLengths as a single fixed-mm track EACH, but only when you haven't authored your own.

inputs.name: CellWidths
inputs.description: Column track sizes (West-to-East): a positive number (mm), 'Nfr', or 'auto'. 'minmax()' not yet resolved.

inputs.name: CellLengths
inputs.description: Row track sizes (North-to-South): same grammar as CellWidths.

inputs.name: CellLabels
inputs.description: Per-cell label grid: rows separated by newlines, cells by commas. Row 0 = North, column 0 = West.

inputs.name: ChildrenJSON
inputs.description: Child Layout2 JSON strings (this same component's JSON output), one per nested region, matched by Label.

inputs.name: BorderOverridesJSON
inputs.description: Border-override JSON strings (from pms-layout2-border-override-v0), one per override on THIS node's own grid -- each selects a border via 'between' and carries an optional 'offset' (mm). See pms-layout-geom2-v0.py's own docstring for how Offset applies to atomic cells.

outputs.name: JSON
outputs.description: Layout2 JSON string. The outermost instance's JSON feeds pms-layout-geom2-v0's (list-access) JSON input.
